sn55.10:1.1: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn55.10:1.2: kakuṭo nāma bhante ñātike upāsako kālakato
sn55.10:1.4: kaḷibho nāma bhante ñātike upāsako. danikaddho
sn55.10:1.10: subhaddo nāma bhante ñātike upāsako kālakato
sn55.10:2.1: kakuṭo ānanda upāsako kālakato pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
sn55.10:2.8: subhaddo ānanda upāsako kālakato pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
sn55.10:3.1: paropaññāsa ānanda ñātike upāsakā kālakatā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyino anāvattidhammā tasmā lokā.
sn55.10:3.2: sādhikanavuti ānanda ñātike upāsakā kālakatā tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karissanti.
sn55.10:3.3: chātirekāni kho ānanda pañcasatāni ñātike upāsakā kālakatā tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyanā.
sn55.10:4.1: anacchariyaṃ kho panetaṃ ānanda yaṃ manussabhūto kālaṃ kareyya
sn55.10:4.2: tasmiṃ tasmiṃ ce maṃ kālakate upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ paṭipucchissatha. vihesāvesā ānanda assa tathāgatassa.
sn55.10:4.3: tasmā tihānanda dhammādāsaṃ nāma dhammapariyāyaṃ desessāmi yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya
sn55.10:4.4: khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapittivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano.
sn55.10:5.1: katamo ca so ānanda dhammādāso dhammapariyāyo yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya
sn55.10:5.2: khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapittivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano.
sn55.10:6.1: idhānanda ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.10:6.4: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akkhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.10:6.5: ayaṃ kho so ānanda dhammādāso dhammapariyāyo
sn55.10:6.6: yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya
sn55.10:6.7: khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapittivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
